aSOPR:  The Spent Output Profit Ratio (SOPR) is computed by dividing the realized value (in USD) divided by the value at creation (USD) of a spent output. Or simply: price sold / price paid.  Adjusted SOPR is SOPR ignoring all outputs with a lifespan of less than 1 hour.
